title: Pocketwire Advance First Late-Fee Period — Collections Standard
content:
The first late-fee period of a Pocketwire Advance is charged on terms that depend on the age of the line. When the period booked is the first late-fee period of the advance and the line was opened at least 365 days before the handling date, the late fee is multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down to the cent; when it is the first period and the line was opened fewer than 365 days before the handling date, the late fee is multiplied by 0.9 and rounded down to the cent; for any later period the late fee is rounded to the cent (half up) as it stands.

**Place of the treatment.** The treatment acts on the late fee of the period as it stands before any rounding, and only its result is then raised to the tier's minimum late fee and held within the tier's late fee cap.

**Age of the line.** The number of calendar days from the opening date of the Pocketwire Advance line to the handling date.

## Ladder

| Period booked | Line opened before the handling date | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| Period 1 | 365 days or more | Multiplied by 0.75, rounded down to the cent |
| Period 1 | Fewer than 365 days | Multiplied by 0.9, rounded down to the cent |
| Period 2 or later | Any | Rounded to the cent (half up) as it stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fee of 1.875 before rounding)

| Period and line | Figure | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Period 1, line opened 400 days before | 1.875 multiplied by 0.75 gives 1.40625 | 1.40 |
| Period 1, line opened 365 days before | 1.875 multiplied by 0.75 gives 1.40625 | 1.40 |
| Period 1, line opened 364 days before | 1.875 multiplied by 0.9 gives 1.6875 | 1.68 |
| Period 2 | 1.875 | 1.88 |

With a late fee of 1.20 before rounding in period 1 on a line opened 500 days before, the treatment gives 0.90; on a tier with a minimum late fee of 1.00 the late fee booked is then raised to 1.00.
